rv.q: Laird's first staged play, runner-up for the Verity Bargate award, still feels in need of another draft.
This new and energetic play brings emotion, laughter and thought-provoking themes to The Other Place in Stratford-upon-Avon this Spring.
However, as the drama moves into the second half, family tensions grow.

cn.t: Martina Laird's family drama set in 1950s Trinidad earns praise for its vivid atmosphere and strong performances, particularly Ellen Thomas's commanding turn as the formidable matriarch Pearl and Cat White's exuberant Ruby.
